title: Returns Centre Service Standard: Fees Absorbed When Inspection Is Posted Late
content:
When the inspection of a Returns & Exchanges return was posted late, Marlowe & Finch absorbs a share of the fee part of the Gift Cards & Store Credit recovery of instant Return Store Credit on that return (the restocking and missing-box fees the recovery includes). Lateness is measured in calendar days from the date the returns centre received the parcel to the return's inspection date, both read from the return.

## Standard

| Inspection date, counted from the date the returns centre received the parcel | Share of the fee part absorbed by Marlowe & Finch |
|---|---|
| More than 14 calendar days after receipt | 1 (the whole fee part) |
| More than 7 but at most 14 calendar days after receipt | 0.5 (half the fee part) |
| At most 7 calendar days after receipt | Nothing absorbed |

The absorbed share is taken off the fee part and what remains is rounded half up to the cent.

## Boundary days (hypothetical return received on 2 March)

| Inspection date | Calendar days after receipt | Absorbed share |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March | 7 | Nothing |
| 10 March | 8 | Half |
| 16 March | 14 | Half |
| 17 March | 15 | The whole fee part |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee part of 13.25)

- Inspected 8 days after receipt: half is absorbed; 6.625 remains and is rounded half up to 6.63.
- Inspected 15 days after receipt: the whole fee part is absorbed; 0.00 remains.
- Inspected 5 days after receipt: nothing is absorbed; 13.25 remains.
